angle_vulkan_driver_injection.description: Mechanisms to bypass vendor OpenGL ES translation driver by injecting ANGLE (Almost Native Graphics Layer Engine) directly backed by Vulkan API, slashing draw call CPU overhead by 30-40%.

system_settings_keys.effect: Semi-global switch forcing all OpenGL ES applications to render through ANGLE Vulkan backend.
Per-package opt-in list targeting high-load games and apps for ANGLE translation.
Forces ANGLE driver selection for packages specified in angle_gl_driver_selection_pkgs.
Suppresses toast and dialog notifications when ANGLE driver is activated.
Defers ANGLE rule parsing to prevent frame startup hitching.

system_properties.effect: Informs graphics loader that ANGLE is supported.
Forces default EGL implementation to ANGLE.
Sets ANGLE backend directly to Vulkan (1=D3D11, 2=Vulkan, 3=OpenGL, 4=Metal).

telemetry_log_suppression.description: Zeroing log buffers, disabling statsd telemetry pulling, and suppressing framework logging tags to eliminate synchronous IPC context switches and return CPU cycles to games.

system_properties.effect: Causes android.util.Log.isLoggable() to return false globally, preventing string formatting and socket writes to /dev/socket/logdw across all processes.
Minimizes logd memory footprint and prevents continuous RAM buffer thrashing.
Stops background logpersist daemon from writing logs to disk/flash storage.
Disables all atrace kernel tracing categories.
Stops Perfetto background tracing daemon.
Stops Binder driver transaction profiling.

shell_commands.purpose: Reduces log ring buffer to absolute minimum and flushes all pending logs.

shell_commands.command: cmd device_config put statsd active false

shell_commands.purpose: Prevents statsd from triggering alarm timers to upload telemetry.

touch_latency_input_pipeline.description: InputFlinger and TouchInputMapper tuning to eliminate artificial touch resampling delays and deliver raw digitizer coordinates with sub-millisecond dispatch.

system_properties.effect: Disables InputConsumer touch resampling, removing the 5ms (RESAMPLE_LATENCY) artificial delay introduced for cubic spline prediction.
Disables touch resampling on devices reading the persist flag.
Disables input latency instrumentation and profiling hooks.
Sets upper ceiling for window manager touch dispatch to 240Hz/360Hz touch sampling rate.

touch_latency_input_pipeline.architectural_logic: By default, InputConsumer buffers touch motion events and subtracts 5ms from sampleTime to perform coordinate interpolation with future estimated points. Setting ro.input.resampling=0 bypasses resampleTouchState(), allowing raw touch events to hit ViewRootImpl immediately upon arrival from kernel evdev.

display_refresh_rate_surfaceflinger.description: Pinning hardware display mode to peak refresh rate (120Hz/144Hz) and eliminating idle drops, thermal blocking zones, and VSYNC phase misalignment.

system_settings_keys.effect: Sets ceiling refresh rate vote in DisplayModeDirector.
Sets floor refresh rate vote in DisplayModeDirector, effectively locking refresh rate at 120Hz.
Eliminates delay when restoring display mode after low-power interruptions.

device_config_keys.effect: Forces 120Hz even when display brightness is high (sunlight).
Forces 120Hz even when display brightness is low (dark room).

surfaceflinger_properties.effect: Disables SurfaceFlinger idle timer completely. Prevents the framework from downclocking display to 60Hz/30Hz when no screen interaction occurs for >200ms.
SurfaceFlinger latches buffers immediately without waiting for fence signal if hardware composer pipeline can process them, saving 1 frame (8.3ms at 120Hz).
Sets early VSYNC phase offset to 0.5ms for minimum latency composition.
App VSYNC phase offset at 120Hz+ aligned to reduce input-to-display delay.
Enables Hardware Composer composition strategy prediction, reducing GPU blit overhead.
Disables GPU composition backpressure queue stall, preventing framerate hitches.

cmd_commands.purpose: Overrides display resolution and refreshrate at hardware display manager level.

hwui_rendering_pipeline.description: Configuring HWUI RenderThread with Skia Vulkan pipeline, partial screen updates, buffer age validation, and asynchronous GPU pixel buffers.

system_properties.effect: Switches HWUI rendering pipeline to Skia Vulkan backend, bypassing OpenGL ES driver state machine.
Enables EGL/Vulkan buffer age tracking, allowing partial updates only on modified pixels.
Enables partial window composition, preventing full framebuffer repainting.
Skips render passes completely when dirty damage rect is zero.
Allocates Pixel Buffer Objects (PBO) for non-blocking bitmap uploads to GPU memory.
Connects RenderThread to ADPF (Android Dynamic Performance Framework) HintManager for optimal CPU/GPU cluster scheduling.
Budgets CPU execution time to 70% of frame deadline, preventing governor under-scaling.
Skia Vulkan combines adjacent draw operations into monolithic render passes, slashing Vulkan pipeline barriers.

cached_app_optimizer_freezer.description: Configuring CachedAppOptimizer, cgroup v2 freezer, and proactive memory compaction to freeze background processes within 1 second and reclaim 100% of background CPU/cache bandwidth.

device_config_keys.effect: Enables the Linux cgroup v2 process freezer.
Reduces freeze delay from default 10,000ms to 1,000ms. Background apps freeze within 1s of losing focus.
Enables proactive ZRAM memory compaction for cached apps.
Full compaction throttle interval set to 2s.
Disables statsd metric collection on freezer events to eliminate telemetry overhead.
Disables statsd metric collection on compaction events.

cmd_commands.purpose: Immediately freezes a target background process.

art_runtime_jit_layout_optimization.description: Full native AOT machine code compilation, layout bytecode pre-compilation, and thread priority tuning to eliminate JIT compilation spikes and layout inflation stutter.

cmd_compilation_commands.purpose: Performs full AOT Ahead-Of-Time compilation of all DEX methods into machine code. Bypasses JIT runtime tiering completely, preventing CPU spikes during gameplay.
Compiles XML layout files directly into executable Java bytecode, bypassing XmlPullParser runtime XML parsing.

art_properties.effect: Maintains ART heap target utilization for balanced GC triggers.
Allows sufficient memory headroom for game textures and render targets.

art_runtime_jit_layout_optimization.layout_pre_inflation_pattern: Asynchronous pre-inflation using background thread pools + ConcurrentLinkedQueue ViewCache to instantiate complex view trees before they are needed on the UI thread.

bionic_allocator_tuning.description: Scudo and Jemalloc allocator memory release and quarantine optimization to prevent memory bloat and allocation latency.

c_jni_apis.effect: Forces Scudo to immediately purge dirty memory pages back to the Linux kernel via madvise(MADV_DONTNEED).
Sets zero-decay time for free memory chunks, eliminating deferred fragmentation.

bionic_allocator_tuning.environment_variables: export SCUDO_OPTIONS="quarantine_max_chunk_size=0:quarantine_size_kb=0" (bypasses Scudo quarantine buffer for deterministic microsecond allocation latency).
